# Discovery Brief

> Owns the discovery record for a deal.

**What it does.** Maintain the discovery record for a pursuit: supported facts and ranked open questions tied to the scope they unblock. Use to prepare discovery content, identify questions that affect scope or price, ingest a post-call transcript, close answered questions, log decisions, or propose scope revisions.
